dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed inductive type of certified matrix-computation runs for a sample space, dimensions, input matrix, and arithmetic model. Constructor D016 packages the state evolution, reflector data, perturbations, exact square factor, computed output, and validity conditions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universal in such a run. The run supplies the output matrix RHat used in the factorization, while its constructor restricts admissible dimensions and executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventh field of a certified run, a random m-by-n real matrix; this is the run's RHat output.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This matrix must be upper trapezoidal and must occur in A + DeltaA = Q RHat for every outcome.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed local-perturbation certificate. Constructor D017 builds it from a measurable probability-one event on which every step perturbation has operator 2-norm at most c5 times the specified gamma factor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A certificate hlocal is universally assumed and indexes all per-column certificates. The constant c5 affects the conclusion only through this assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed certificate for one matrix column. Constructor D018 supplies a measurable event, a column perturbation, and a quadratic remainder satisfying an exact backward relation, a complement-probability bound, and a columnwise norm bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The hypothesis perColumn supplies one such certificate for every column and is the structured source of the simultaneous event and columnwise conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive arithmetic-probability model. Constructor D019 packages a normalized measure, exact and computed operation values, bounded relative errors, a unit roundoff in [0,1), measurability, integrability, zero means, and the sequential moment-factorization condition D032.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The model supplies the probability measure and unit roundoff used throughout the probability bound, coefficient, and remainder conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first field of the model, namely a measure on the sample space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its real-valued measure of the existential good event is compared with 1 - 2mn exp(-lambda^2).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventh field of the model, namely its real unit-roundoff parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is substituted into the perturbation coefficient and both remainder functions. Model construction ensures 0 <= u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a function r and reference u0, this asserts that there is C >= 0 such that r(u) = O(u^2) as u tends to zero and |r(u)| <= C u^2 whenever |u| <= |u0|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every column remainder at each outcome and the normwise remainder at each outcome must satisfy this second-order condition at the model unit roundoff.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of an m-by-n real matrix: the square root of the sum of the squares of all entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the normwise perturbation inequality for DeltaA and A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a square matrix Q, this asserts sum_k Q(k,i)Q(k,j) = delta_ij for all i,j, equivalently Q has orthonormal columns and Q^T Q = I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential matrix Q(omega) must satisfy this condition for every outcome.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 1 - 2mn exp(-lambda^2), with m and n cast to real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the exact lower bound imposed on the real-valued probability of the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient c6 lambda sqrt(n) gamma_m(lambda,u), where gamma_m(lambda,u) = exp((lambda sqrt(m)u + m u^2)/(1-u)) - 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the model unit roundoff, this coefficient multiplies each original column norm and the Frobenius norm of A in the perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary matrix multiplication: (QR)(i,j) = sum_k Q(i,k)R(k,j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the exact identity A + DeltaA(omega) = Q(omega)RHat(omega).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m-by-n matrix R, every entry R(i,j) with j < i is zero; this is upper-trapezoidal structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: RHat(omega) must have this structure for every outcome.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean 2-norm of a finite real vector: sqrt(sum_i x(i)^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures columns of A and DeltaA and appears in the operator-norm assumptions encoded by the certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a certified run. It requires n <= m and 0 < n; normalized reflector vectors; a state recurrence using matrices I - vv^T plus local perturbations; an exact factor built from the reflectors; orthogonality of that factor; identification of RHat with the final state and designated computed values; and upper-trapezoidal RHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the mathematical content of the run binder and explains why run.RHat is a computed upper-trapezoidal matrix associated with an exact orthogonal factor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a local certificate. It uses a measurable event E with measure exactly one, characterized by the condition that every local perturbation has operator 2-norm at most c5 gamma_m(lambda,u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the assumption represented by hlocal and supplies the local event used inside each per-column certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a column certificate. For a column j it requires a measurable event E_j contained in the local event, mu.real(E_j complement) <= 2m exp(-lambda^2), a perturbation d_j and quadratic remainder r_j, the exact relation A(:,j)+d_j = exactQ RHat(:,j), and the stated norm bound on E_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: One instance is assumed for every column. These certificates encode the individual backward-error identities, second-order remainders, and high-probability column bounds combined by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for the arithmetic model. It requires mu(univ)=1, computed_k = exact_k(1+error_k), |error_k| <= u, 0 <= u < 1, measurable integrable mean-zero errors, and the sequential factorization property D032.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the model's measure a probability measure and constrains the unit roundoff and random errors underlying all run and certificate assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Kronecker delta delta_ij, equal to 1 when i=j and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the identity matrix in the orthogonality condition and in the reflector matrix I - vv^T.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function gamma_k(lambda,u) = exp((lambda sqrt(k)u + k u^2)/(1-u)) - 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With k=m it appears in both the local-perturbation assumption and the coefficient c6 lambda sqrt(n) gamma_m(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 1+1 satisfies the AtLeastTwo predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is elaboration support for the exponent numeral 2 and adds no independent mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a real function is big-O of u^2 with respect to the neighborhood filter at zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the asymptotic component of every required second-order remainder condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ninth field of a certified run, its outcome-dependent exact m-by-m matrix exactQ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Per-column certificates use this matrix in their exact backward relations; the target then asserts existence of an orthogonal Q giving the simultaneous relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of a certified run, the outcome- and step-dependent local perturbation matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its operator norms are controlled on the probability-one local event encoded by hlocal.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first field of a local certificate, namely its local event.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every event contained in a per-column certificate is required to be a subset of this event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of the arithmetic model, the computed value for each indexed operation and outcome.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run constructor identifies every RHat entry with one of these computed operation values.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third field of the arithmetic model, the natural number of indexed operations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the finite index type used to associate computed operation values with RHat entries.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a step j, vector x, and reflector vector v, it asserts v_i=0 for i<j and ((I-vv^T)x)_i=0 for i>j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This run invariant makes each reflector eliminate entries below the current diagonal position and supports upper-trapezoidal RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square matrix H(v) with entries delta_ij - v_i v_j, namely I - vv^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact reflector used in the state and exact-factor recurrences encoded by a certified run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The step-j state update formed from PB, except entries below the diagonal in column j are explicitly set to zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the run's matrix-state recurrence whose final state is RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every error index k and every function g of earlier errors, whenever both relevant random variables are integrable, the integral of g(previous errors) times error_k factors as the product of their integrals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the model's sequential moment-factorization assumption underlying its probability certificates; it is not restated in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix operator bound ||Ax||_2 <= L||x||_2 for every finite vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the local perturbation bound that holds for every step on hlocal's probability-one event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i = sum_j A(i,j)x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in the operator-norm predicate and reflector elimination condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: For error index k, this is the vector consisting of errors with indices 0 through k-1 at the given outcome.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the previous-error argument of g in the model's sequential moment-factorization condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that an index i below k, with k itself a valid step index, is also below the total number of steps.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates the embedding of earlier error indices in D035 and has no separate mathematical conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires all measurability, remainder, probability, factorization, structure, and error-bound clauses simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses exact matrix identities, orthogonality equations, zero entries, and the equalities inside the structured assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies the good event, Q, DeltaA, column remainders, and normwise remainder in that order.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin k is the finite index type whose values are natural numbers strictly below k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies row, column, operation, and recurrence indices and fixes all matrix dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes pointwise matrix addition A+DeltaA and ordinary real addition in all scalar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes real scalar multiplication and products in norms, coefficients, matrix products, and probabilistic formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies all probability and norm inequalities; for constructor data it also expresses nonnegativity.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positivity of c5, c6, and lambda and the index inequalities defining triangular structure.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSet
dependency_coverage.meaning: The predicate that a set belongs to the supplied measurable-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential good event is required to be measurable.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measurable-space structure specifying the measurable subsets of a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is parameterized by such a structure on Ω, allowing its events and measures to be defined.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number obtained by applying a measure to a set and converting its extended-nonnegative-real value with toReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the exact interpretation of the good-event probability in the lower bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Membership.mem
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected membership.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For sets it expresses omega belonging to the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of m, n, c5, c6, operation counts, and finite-index bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass interpretation of a natural-number literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets literals such as 0, 1, and 2 in natural and real expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of dependent functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied twice, it makes addition of m-by-n matrices pointwise, so (A+DeltaA)(i,j)=A(i,j)+DeltaA(i,j).

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, parameters, norms, coefficients, probabilities after conversion, and remainders are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every real addition in the target and its definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies negation and subtraction infrastructure used by absolute value and real formulas, without adding a hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary non-strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual interpretation of all real inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual meaning to 0 < lambda and to model inequalities involving real parameters.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all scalar products in the coefficient, norms, matrix operations, and probability bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets zero entries, nonnegativity, positivity, and zero-mean conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice structure induced by the usual order on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group, it defines real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Set
dependency_coverage.meaning: A set of elements of α, represented as a predicate α -> Prop.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The good event and the events contained in the certificates are sets of outcomes.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.instMembership
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard membership relation for predicate-represented sets.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets omega in goodEvent and all event-membership statements.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of the numeral 0 from a Zero instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real zero used in the positivity assumptions and formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In an ordered additive group, abs(a)=max(a,-a); for reals this is ordinary absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds the column remainders, model errors, and second-order remainder magnitudes.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-addition instance induced by an ordinary Add instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HAdd notation to ordinary matrix or real addition and adds no mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-multiplication instance induced by an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HMul notation to ordinary real multiplication and adds no mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 0<c5, 0<c6, finite-index comparisons, n>0, and triangularity comparisons.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of each natural numeral as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literals appearing in positivity, indexing, powers, and recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite-type structure enumerating all members of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes sums over every row or column index finite and exhaustive.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines comparisons such as j<i and the embedding of previous operation indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines matrix products, Euclidean and Frobenius norms, orthogonality, and reflector normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each sum range over every valid finite index.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents real squares such as u^2, lambda^2, and squared matrix entries.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents 1 minus a probability tail, exp(...) minus 1, I-vv^T, and the denominator 1-u.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measure on a measurable space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the model's probability measure and underlies all event probabilities and integrals.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation supplied by a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it gives the ordinary powers used for squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast of a natural number into a type with a NatCast structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts c6, m, n, and related counts into real scalars in analytic formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms -lambda^2 and supports subtraction and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of the numeral 1 from a One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real and measure-codomain units in probability and exponential formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary real exponential function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the failure-probability term exp(-lambda^2) and in gamma_m(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the finite real sums defining norms, products, and orthogonality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary natural powers of real values.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical casting structure from natural numbers to real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the real interpretations of m, n, c5, c6, and the numeral 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all negative real expressions, especially -lambda^2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 1 in the probability threshold, gamma expression, and arithmetic model.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the negative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the subtractions in the probability threshold, gamma factor, reflector, and denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square root.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean and Frobenius norms and the factors sqrt(m) and sqrt(n).

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality on finite indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the Kronecker delta to test whether two row indices are equal.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-power interface induced by an ordinary power operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes power notation to ordinary real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-subtraction interface induced by an ordinary Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes subtraction notation to ordinary real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: An instance interpreting a natural numeral n by casting it when the AtLeastTwo guard is available.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It elaborates the real exponent numeral 2 and does not impose a substantive target assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from an additive commutative monoid with one to its additive-monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports interpretation of the value 1 in the extended-nonnegative-real measure codomain.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection extracting a One structure from an additive monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the value one used in the normalization mu(univ)=1.

dependency_coverage.name: Asymptotics.IsBigO
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard asymptotic big-O relation between two functions along a filter, using their norms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the neighborhood filter of zero it states that each required remainder grows no faster than a constant multiple of u^2 locally.

dependency_coverage.name: Compl.compl
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected complement.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For sets it forms the complement of each per-column good event in its failure-probability bound.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coercion of a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits a measure to be evaluated on a set in the model and certificate definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: DecidableEq
dependency_coverage.meaning: A procedure deciding equality of any two elements of a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is needed to define the finite-index Kronecker delta and contributes no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection extracting division from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies division by 1-u in gamma_k(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, represented as nonnegative reals with a top element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the native codomain of measures before Measure.real converts event measures to real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: The embedding Fin n -> Fin(n+1) preserving the underlying index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It refers to the current state at step j in the run recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.instOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interpretation of a natural numeral as a finite index modulo a known nonzero bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the initial state index 0 in Fin(n+1).

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.last
dependency_coverage.meaning: The final index n in Fin(n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the final matrix state RHat and the final exact-factor state.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The successor embedding sending j in Fin n to j+1 in Fin(n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the next state after processing column j.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms the quotient in gamma_k(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: HasSubset.Subset
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-selected subset relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires every per-column good event to lie inside the probability-one local event.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It characterizes hlocal's event exactly as the outcomes satisfying all local operator-norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed-space structure inherited from an inner-product space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies standard real normed-space infrastructure needed for integration; it adds no separate target condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Measurable
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function is measurable when preimages of measurable sets are measurable.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The model requires every operation-error function to be measurable.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Integrable
dependency_coverage.meaning: The conjunction of almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite integral norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains each model error and guards the moment-factorization equations in D032.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function-like structure making a measure act on sets with values in ENNReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets expressions such as mu(E), mu(univ), and mu(E complement).

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.integral
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Bochner integral of a normed-space-valued function with respect to a measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real-valued functions it defines error means and the moment-factorization condition in the model.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.AtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: A predicate on natural numbers used as a guard for numerals at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears only in typeclass elaboration for the numeral 2 and contributes no explicit proposition-level condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given that n is nonzero, it proves the AtLeastTwo predicate for n+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports finite-index and numeral elaboration in the run constructor without changing the mathematical statement.

binders: An arbitrary type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
Natural dimensions m and n and a real matrix A indexed by Fin m times Fin n.
An arithmetic-probability model containing a normalized measure mu, a unit roundoff u, and the operation-error data and conditions described by D019.
A certified run for A and the model. Its constructor data entail n <= m, 0 < n, a reflector-based state recurrence, an exact orthogonal factor, and an outcome-dependent computed matrix RHat.
Positive natural constants c5 and c6 and a positive real parameter lambda.
A local certificate hlocal for run, c5, and lambda.
For every column j in Fin n, a per-column certificate indexed by run, c5, c6, lambda, and hlocal.
hypotheses: The model's constructor assumptions include mu(univ)=1, 0 <= u < 1, bounded measurable integrable mean-zero relative operation errors, and the sequential moment-factorization property D032.

The run's constructor assumptions include n <= m, 0 < n, the stated matrix-state and exact-factor recurrences, orthogonality of its exact factor, and identification of RHat with the final computed upper-trapezoidal state.
The local certificate provides a measurable event of measure exactly one characterized by the bounds ||localPerturbation_j(omega)||_2 <= c5 gamma_m(lambda,u) for every j.

For each column j, the per-column certificate provides a measurable event E_j contained in the local event, with mu.real(E_j complement) <= 2m exp(-lambda^2), together with a column perturbation and a second-order remainder satisfying the exact column relation and the corresponding norm bound on E_j.
conclusions: There exist, in order, a set goodEvent contained in Ω, a function Q assigning an m-by-m real matrix to each outcome, a function DeltaA assigning an m-by-n real matrix to each outcome, column remainders r_j(u,omega), and a normwise remainder rho(u,omega).
For every column j and outcome omega, u' -> r_j(u',omega) is O((u')^2) near zero and admits a constant C_{j,omega} >= 0 such that |r_j(u',omega)| <= C_{j,omega}(u')^2 whenever |u'| <= |u|.
For every outcome omega, u' -> rho(u',omega) is O((u')^2) near zero and admits a constant C_omega >= 0 such that |rho(u',omega)| <= C_omega(u')^2 whenever |u'| <= |u|.
For every outcome omega, RHat(omega) is upper trapezoidal, Q(omega)^T Q(omega)=I, and A+DeltaA(omega)=Q(omega)RHat(omega) exactly.
For every omega in goodEvent and every column j, ||DeltaA(omega)(:,j)||_2 <= alpha ||A(:,j)||_2 + |r_j(u,omega)|.
For every omega in goodEvent, ||DeltaA(omega)||_F <= alpha ||A||_F + rho(u,omega).
mathematical_definitions: Fin k is the index set {0,...,k-1}; thus A and DeltaA are m-by-n matrices, Q is m-by-m, and RHat is m-by-n.
mu is model.probability, u is model.unitRoundoff, and RHat(omega) is the seventh field of run.
For a vector x, ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2). For a matrix B, ||B||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j B_ij^2).
For matrices Q and R, (QR)_ij = sum_k Q_ik R_kj. Matrix addition is entrywise.
Q^T Q=I means sum_k Q_ki Q_kj equals 1 when i=j and 0 otherwise.
RHat is upper trapezoidal precisely when RHat_ij=0 whenever j<i.
alpha = c6 lambda sqrt(n) gamma_m(lambda,u) = c6 lambda sqrt(n) (exp((lambda sqrt(m)u + m u^2)/(1-u)) - 1).
A second-order remainder condition at u means existence of C>=0 with r=O(t^2) as t tends to zero and |r(t)|<=Ct^2 for every |t|<=|u|.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every certified arithmetic model and certified run of the m-by-n matrix A, every positive c5, c6, and lambda, and every supplied local and per-column certificate, one can choose a single measurable event of real-valued probability at least 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2), outcome-dependent matrices Q and DeltaA, and second-order remainder functions. For every outcome, Q has orthonormal columns, RHat is upper trapezoidal, and A+DeltaA=Q RHat exactly. On the chosen event, every column perturbation is bounded by alpha times the corresponding column norm plus the absolute column remainder, and the Frobenius norm of DeltaA is bounded by alpha times the Frobenius norm of A plus the signed normwise remainder, where alpha=c6 lambda sqrt(n)(exp((lambda sqrt(m)u+m u^2)/(1-u))-1).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although m and n are quantified as arbitrary naturals, inhabitation of the certified-run type entails 0<n and n<=m. In particular, the outer statement has no non-vacuous run instance when n=0 or n>m.
The statement is universal in model, run, hlocal, and perColumn objects. If any required indexed certificate type is uninhabited, the corresponding universal quantification is vacuous.
The lower probability bound can be negative when 2mn exp(-lambda^2)>1, in which case that clause alone is weak or automatic.
No additional lower bound on lambda is imposed to make the probability threshold positive or close to one.

The factorization, orthogonality of Q, and upper-trapezoidal structure of RHat hold for every outcome, not merely almost everywhere or on goodEvent. Only the perturbation inequalities are restricted to goodEvent.
The final goodEvent is not asserted to equal or be contained in the local event or any particular per-column event, even though the supplied certificates internally contain such events.
The constants in the second-order remainder bounds may depend on the column and outcome for column remainders, and on the outcome for the normwise remainder; no uniform constant is asserted.
No measurability or integrability is required of Q, DeltaA, the column remainders, or the normwise remainder as functions of omega.
The normwise inequality adds rho(u,omega) without an absolute value, even though the second-order condition controls |rho|. This signed use is materially different from the columnwise bound.
The witnesses may depend on all universally quantified inputs and certificates, and later existential witnesses may depend on the previously chosen goodEvent.

The model imposes bounded, measurable, integrable, mean-zero errors and the specific sequential moment-factorization property, but the target does not separately assert identical distributions or a general standalone independence statement.
The target asserts no uniqueness of Q or DeltaA, no rank condition on A, no sign or nonzero condition on diagonal entries of RHat, and no forward-error estimate.
The constant c5 does not occur explicitly in the final bounds; it affects the proposition only through the existence and content of hlocal and the per-column certificates.
The probability is specifically Measure.real, the toReal conversion of the measure's ENNReal value. Finiteness follows in non-vacuous model instances from total mass one.
Because n<=m, the condition RHat_ij=0 for j<i also forces every entry in rows i>=n to vanish, so RHat is upper trapezoidal rather than merely square-upper-triangular.
